title: Collision Plancherel = Shaw second-moment on a different group: the moment-collision scalar (F5/F15) and the line-incidence Shaw error (F3) as ONE Plancherel energy
wall: W-BGK / W-Paley (worst-case incomplete subgroup character sum M(n)=max_{b!=0}|eta_b|, eta_b=sum_{x in mu_n} psi_b(x) = generalized-Paley non-principal eigenvalue / Paley Graph Conjecture). C091 fuses the F5/F15 deep-moment face and the F3 Shaw line-incidence face onto this ONE wall but yields no new bound on M(n).
evidence: Exact/high-precision probe scripts/probes/_407_conn/C091_plancherel_metalemma.py, PRIZE REGIME ONLY (proper dyadic mu_n < F_q*, n|q-1, (q-1)/n>1, q~n^beta beta in [4,5]; n=8 q in {4129,4153}, n=16 q in {65537,65617}; order-n generator verified pow(x,n,q)=1 and exact order n). THREE separable claims graded independently. (PROVEN — the structural unification, the actual content of why_insightful) The abstract meta-lemma 'plancherel_energy(f)*|G| = sum_psi ||fhat(psi)||^2, fhat(psi)=sum_x f(x)psi(x)' is a genuine finite-abelian-group Plancherel identity (verified exactly on Z_7,Z_13,Z_16), and BOTH cited in-tree lemmas are literal instances of it: MomentCollisionSpectral.plancherel_collision (collision*|A| = sum_{psi over A} ||T_psi||^2, T_psi = sum_{|S|=a} psi(stat S)) is Plancherel of the statistic-histogram N:A->N on group A; ShawSecondMoment.shawError_second_moment / parseval_indicator (sum_{s0} ||Shaw||^2 = |V|*sum_{psi perp s1, psi!=0} ||1hat_S(psi)||^2, full version sum_all ||1hat_S||^2 = |V||S|) is Plancherel of 1_S:V->{0,1} on group V. Both identities hold EXACTLY at every prize prime (collision*q = sum_b||T_b||^2 = (C(n,a))^2 + offdiag, all matches True; parseval_indicator sum_all||eta_b||^2 = |V||S| exactly, e.g. n=8 q=4129: 33032 = 4129*8). The per-character objects share the SAME partial subgroup character data {psi_b(x): x in mu_n}: at a=1 the collision coefficient T_b = e_1 = eta_b is LITERALLY the Shaw 1hat_S(b)=eta_b, and the collision off-diagonal equals the Shaw unrestricted mass EXACTLY up to the structural |V| factor (n=8 q=4129: off_a1 = sum_{b!=0}||eta_b||^2 = 32968, Shaw mass = |V|*32968 = 136124872, ratio = 4129 = q exactly). Newton's identity links higher a: T_b(a=2) = e_2 = (eta_b^2 - eta_{2b})/2 (Newton-match=True at b=1,3,5). So 'the deep-moment/list-supply face and the Shaw line-incidence face are two faces of ONE Plancherel energy on different dual groups, both bottoming out in the same incomplete subgroup char sum' is CORRECT. (REFUTED — the HEADLINE literal equation) 'the off-diagonal sum_{psi!=0} ||T_psi||^2 in MomentCollisionSpectral IS the Shaw operator's L^2 mass' is FALSE as a numerical identity for a>=2: collision-offdiag(a=2) vs Shaw-mass(S=mu_n) = 164376 vs 136124872 (n=8 q=4129, ratio 828), 11520112 vs 68704796432 (n=16 q=65537, ratio 5964) — diverging, NOT equal. Reason: collision T_b is the elementary-symmetric e_a over a-element SUBSETS, Shaw 1hat_S=eta_b is the linear e_1 over single ELEMENTS; Shaw also carries an extra |V| factor and (in the true Shaw) a hyperplane restriction psi perp s1. SAME Plancherel template, DIFFERENT scalar. (OPEN — welds to BGK) Both off-diagonals are governed by {eta_b}: the average / L^2 mass is FREE in both (= Parseval = q*n) and the worst case is M(n)=max_{b!=0}|eta_b| = the generalized-Paley non-principal eigenvalue (BGK / Paley Graph Conjecture, 25-yr open). C091 unifies two FACES of this wall (genuine 'two walls are one' insight) but the meta-lemma transmits only the L^2 mass, which is already known both sides; it produces no new upper bound on M(n).
